question: Will Ukraine get its missile warnings back, yes or no?

lines.text: Zelensky says Russia fired 16 ballistic missiles at Kyiv and the region overnight.
And he says that, once again, there was no early warning from partners.

scene.quote: once again, there was no early warning from our partners

lines.text: Explosions came in waves: just before 11pm, then around 3am and 7am.
The US supplies the intelligence used to track Russian missile launches.
The Air Force says partners gave no warning of the first wave, but did for the second.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said: What happened last night I don't know exactly.

scene.quote: What happened last night I don't know exactly

lines.text: In Kyiv, a 25-storey block was hit and two metro stations shut for repairs.
Emergency services say one person was killed and eight injured in the capital.
In nearby Irpin, officials say six were injured, three of them children.
Operator Datagroup says one of its data centres was destroyed beyond repair.
Zelensky says energy sites were hit in 11 regions, and 550,000 families lost power.
He says the war continues solely because of Russian strikes.

scene.quote: it continues solely because of Russian strikes
